datasetSummary: Nine recorded cases contain eight samples each: 72 samples with 17 anatomical joints and two role-labelled source views. Source frames [0, 19, 38, 57, 75, 94, 113, 132] retain the complete 2.2-second movement span. They are generated by the existing midpoint solver; drift checks preserve metadata, nulls and reasons exactly with 1.1e-6 numerical rounding tolerance. The fixture shrank 33.3%, from 1,477,162 to 985,509 bytes, without removing a scenario, joint, quality gate or solver test. It establishes no physical accuracy.
browserSummary: Real Vite-server UI acceptance passed at 1440×1050, 390×844 and 320×740, English. All nine cases, coordinates/references, missing and named joint failures, bounded playback/scrub/keyboard, mode isolation and device-role recovery passed. Six explicit camera-metadata requests, zero acquisition attempts, streams, POST controls or getUserMedia calls, and zero browser errors. Baseline console idle status and planning device metadata use clearly synthetic HTTP fixtures.
